name: gen-local-3d
description: Image-to-3D on this machine's GPU: Pixal3D (single view) and TRELLIS.2 through pixal3d.cpp's trellis-cli. No account, no key, no cost per model.

setup.title: Get trellis-cli
setup.detail: Download or build pixal3d.cpp and keep its folder together: trellis-cli.exe needs the CUDA and ggml DLLs beside it. Everything runs on this machine; nothing is sent anywhere.

setup.title: Download the model weights
setup.detail: One folder per model under a single models folder: pixal3d-sv/ holds the nine GGUF files of raven38/pixal3d-sv-q8_0-v1, trellis2-gguf/q8/ holds the q8 files of ilintar/trellis2-gguf. A model whose folder is missing or incomplete is simply not offered.

setup.title: Give it transparent cutouts
setup.detail: Each job takes ONE PNG with the background already removed. A PNG whose alpha cuts nothing out is refused, because the backdrop would be built as geometry. A job holds the GPU for several minutes.

form.label: trellis-cli path
form.help: The full path of the trellis-cli executable.

form.label: Models folder
form.help: The folder that holds one subfolder of weights per model (pixal3d-sv, trellis2-gguf/q8).
